files.name: query.sql

prompt.vi: Tạo view tên v_expensive là các sản phẩm (id, name, price) có price >= 4000000.
prompt.en: Create a view named v_expensive holding the products (id, name, price) with price >= 4000000.

hint.vi: CREATE VIEW ten AS SELECT … WHERE …;
hint.en: CREATE VIEW name AS SELECT … WHERE …;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
CREATE VIEW v_expensive AS
SELECT id, name, price FROM products WHERE price >= 4000000;

prompt.vi: Tạo bảng stock_log(product_id, old_stock, new_stock) và trigger AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON products tự ghi dòng vào stock_log. Sau đó chạy UPDATE giảm stock sản phẩm 1 đi 2. stock_log phải có đúng 1 dòng.
prompt.en: Create a table stock_log(product_id, old_stock, new_stock) and a trigger AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON products that writes a row to stock_log. Then run an UPDATE reducing product 1's stock by 2. stock_log must have exactly 1 row.

hint.vi: Trong trigger, OLD.stock và NEW.stock là giá trị trước/sau.
hint.en: Inside the trigger, OLD.stock and NEW.stock are the before/after values.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: UPDATE products SET stock = stock - 2 WHERE id = 1;
